purpose: Modernize legacy application while preserving functional parity and business controls.
intended_audience: Business analysts, product owners, delivery leads, and modernization engineering teams.
scope_note: Scope In covers active forms from analyzed project variants. Scope Out lists legacy/orphan stub files that are not carried forward. Similar names can appear in both when one artifact is active and another is superseded: closeacount.frm.
assumptions: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
constraints: Modernization must preserve validated business outcomes for all active in-scope workflows.
Legacy behavior is reconstructed from static analysis evidence and requires business confirmation where traceability is incomplete.
Applicable compliance obligations must be confirmed and linked to the identified security and privacy risks before delivery sign-off.
Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
Two in-scope operational workflows have incomplete extracted interaction evidence and require confirmation before sprint planning is finalized.
scope_validation: Scope is derived from resolved active-form membership, traceability evidence, and analyst review of legacy project files.
compliance_security_summary: Sensitive customer and transaction data must be protected through validation, access control, and secure data handling.
Identified security and compliance risks must be resolved before production approval.
Legacy data-access patterns indicate SQL injection exposure and insufficient query hardening; the target solution must use parameterized queries and secure data-access controls.
current_state_summary: Legacy VB6 estate with mixed modernization readiness and form-level traceability.
target_state_summary: Deliver parity-first modernized application with validated business workflows.
project_background: This modernization initiative targets a legacy estate with 13 discovered workflows, 30 extracted business rules, and 13 platform dependencies.
The delivery objective is parity-first modernization: preserve current business outcomes, make controls explicit, and provide auditable traceability from legacy behavior to target design.
Risk-led priorities are applied from discovery evidence, including 25 registered modernization risks and explicit decision gates for scope, security, and compliance.
business_goals: Establish an approved and traceable modernization baseline.

definitions_and_acronyms.definition: Linkage between business requirement and legacy evidence.
Project-specific implementation of a shared business module.
